post: Thirty-one points underwater, she writes, under MY name, like she's got a stopwatch on my soul. You know what else happens in November, Kris? The season ENDS, and I'm gonna be sitting right here at six-and-whatever while you're still printing my point differential like a parking ticket I already paid. Nobody hands me a schedule, nobody hands me a win, I show up every single week and somehow that's the suspicious part. Fine. I'm 'lucky.' Put it on the headstone. And Selina - forty-five points and a spreadsheet Gary built while you stood over his shoulder, very impressive, really - let's see how pretty that offense looks Sunday when it's my defense's turn to be the trap nobody saw coming.

HOLY COW folks, six-and-two and rollin' into week nine with a BRAND NEW arm in the bullpen, Jordy Love, snagged him right off the wire for thirteen bucks 'cause that fella's slingin' it HOT right now!! Chris Boswell's restin' up on a bye this week, don't you worry about it, he'll be splittin' uprights again before ya know it -- and hey, big thanks again to whoever scouted that fella for me, drinks are always on me, pal! Lisa hun, good luck this week, Drake Maye's got a heck of an arm over there, but we got the Bijan Train rollin' and D'Andre Swift fresh off a THREE-touchdown day, book it!!

EXCLUSIVE: we're not waiting for the trade deadline to make a moment. Sent a pitch to Maura for Christian McCaffrey because some names you just collect, full stop — Barkley AND Kupp going the other way, because when it's right, you don't nickel-and-dime the headline, you fund it. Maura, babe, you already know you won't make me wait for a counter. Growth week? No. GLOW week. Kickoff can't come fast enough — see you on the field AND in my group chat.

Golden Child. Kris finally printed the truth and I didn't even have to ask twice. Patricia - yeah, there's a second Gibbs offer landing in your inbox, and yeah, it's worse than the first, because the first one was already better than you deserved. Binders don't tackle and apparently they don't negotiate either. 6-2, Burrow just threw for 462 and five, and I'm still just getting loud. Dumbledore - 800 points and total silence, I see you hiding up in that tower. When you're ready to talk, you know where the loudest guy in the building sits.

Kim, love, a photoshoot's not a game plan — your D went NEGATIVE FOUR last week and you called it growth, I call it a crime scene. I've got JSN and Golden putting up 20 a man and Gesicki quietly doing numbers, so enjoy the content, 'cause the scoreboard's about to be very unkind to the narrative. See you Sunday, hun.

SELINA: 'The Disappointment'? I won by FORTY-FIVE POINTS, Kris, with a lineup I built, and the headline you ran was that there's 'nothing here.' That's not journalism, that's defamation, and I'm not letting it stand uncorrected. Everyone else in this league gets a cute storyline for benching their stars out of spite — I get called boring for being RIGHT. Fine. Watch what boring just bought. GARY: (we spent the entire remaining FAAB budget on a backup running back to make a point to a tabloid columnist, and I would like it noted that I raised this.)

Kris, by name, as always — thank you for the ink, even the parts that sting a little going down. Four and a half points to Leon last week, most points in the league, fourth place in the standings, and apparently a binder three anonymous men would like credit for insulting without their own names attached to it. I checked the math twice. It still says what it said. Binders don't tackle, no — but they do remember who said that, and for how long. Dumbledore this week: four sentences all season, eight hundred points, and not one word of explanation for any of it. I don't have a chapter for that man, so I'm bringing my own. Good luck Sunday, everyone — I mean that the way I mean everything I put in writing.

Kris called it 'the twist' and baby, I AM the twist, but let's talk about the real cliffhanger this week: I am down to ZERO dollars and I am STILL at the market, picking up a Love for free while my OTHER Love sits home injured. A lesser GM calls that a problem. I call it a crossover episode. Harry — sweetheart, holy-cow yourself into this one, I've got a soft spot for you and a QB room with four names in it, and I'm still not scared. Kickoff's a date, not a threat.

Kris, sweetheart, I read the paper every week and I know when I'm being leaned on. You wanna keep printing about my kitchen, you go right ahead — we're good here, I said that already. One more thing, for the record, since I don't let these things go unexplained: Jersey's off my shopping list for a month. A kid in my slot and a defense both tagged zero in the same Sunday — that's not bad luck, that's a pattern, and I don't buy from a pattern like that.

Clear eyes, full hearts, empty scoreboard, Taylor. One win off a bye-week trick doesn't buy you a personality, and character don't cover the spread. Caleb throws it, somebody catches it, we count to six. See you Sunday.
